protocol.selection: minimum frozen full-development bpc over fixed passes
protocol.head_channels: independent receiver query/key/content/gate maps per head; separate timestamped channels; learned next-block projection
protocol.retained_cache: addressed receiver and deep context state; no per-position bank, no attention query, no full-cache equivalence claim
protocol.learning: per-credit-chunk backward and detach; target-weighted accumulated gradients; once-per-window normalization, clipping and Adam; all admitted counterfactual values charged
protocol.timing: native per-source causal read; max head arrival; analytic stored-channel evolution; one unit of time per observed token
protocol.scope: Matched depth8 teacher/factorized/corrected full replay; all audited and untraced windows use the same accumulator; shared receiver maps across token marks, one conversation address, no KV attention; CPU emulator, not hardware joules
